propositions: event data containing live credentials (API keys, PATs, tokens) are accepted by the write path and published to the shared tickets branch, triggering GitHub push protection rejection and wedging all concurrent agents' store writes
the store write path has no content screening; _validate_event checks envelope shape and event_type only, never inspecting the data payload

multiple write paths bypass append_event (reconciler inbound translate, txn/delete cores) by calling finalize_event halves directly, leaving a content screen in append_event unable to protect against Jira-sourced credential injection
writes matching high-confidence secret patterns must be refused (not redacted) at _seam.finalize_event with an audited force override, leaving no path that accepts credentials without detection

the refusal must name the matched secret family and field location without echoing the credential value, and must be safe to leave on by default given a measured false-positive rate of 1 across 25,125 live events
shell command substitution expands before rebar receives input, making environment dumps and scripted comment bodies an attack surface requiring documentation of the hazard and correct quoting
